title: Installments Paid Ahead with an Initial TRICARE Prime Payment
content:
An initial payment on a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment pays installments ahead as follows: where the enrollment's payment arrangement is a recurring card or electronic funds transfer, the method has not yet started and no installment on the account covers a month after the current month, the initial payment also pays one installment ahead; where the arrangement is a retired-pay allotment, it has not yet started and no installment covers a month after the current month, it pays two installments ahead; otherwise it pays none ahead.

## Truth table

| Method | Method has started | An installment covers a month after the current month | Installments paid ahead |
|---|---|---|---|
| recurring card or electronic funds transfer | no | no | 1 |
| allotment | no | no | 2 |
| any | yes | - | 0 |
| any | - | yes | 0 |
| single card payment or check | - | - | 0 |

An installment covers a month after the current month when its coverage period ends after the current month. The installments paid ahead are added to the initial payment.
